Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline can resolve this now with direct payments to every identified member. We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically, plus $6 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval. Any fees the court does not award would go to the class. We are open to discussing the amounts, but automatic distribution is important given Brightline’s records.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We agree that direct, automatic payments are appropriate given the available records. To resolve the case promptly, Brightline offers a $27 million class fund plus $5 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Any unawarded fees would go to the class.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate Brightline’s agreement to automatic payments and to directing any unawarded fees to the class. To bridge the remaining gap, we propose a $30 million class fund and $5.5 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval, with the other terms unchanged.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate your movement and agree that automatic payments and directing any unawarded fees to the class should remain in place. Brightline can increase its offer to a $28.5 million class fund plus $5.25 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate Brightline’s movement and our agreement on automatic payments and directing any unawarded fees to the class. We can narrow the gap further: a $29.5 million class fund and $5.35 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval, with the remaining terms unchanged.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We are close. Brightline can offer a $29 million class fund and $5.3 million in fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Automatic distribution and the other agreed terms remain unchanged.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We accept Brightline’s latest term sheet: a $29 million class fund with automatic payments, plus $5.3 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval, no clear-sailing provision, and any unawarded fees going to the class.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: As interim class counsel, we negotiated the settlement with Brightline’s counsel over several rounds. Both class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed from the outset; we did not defer fee discussions until after agreement on class relief. The parties agreed to a $29 million class fund distributed automatically to identified class members, plus $5.3 million in fees and expenses paid separately by Brightline, subject to court approval. There is no clear-sailing provision, and any fees not awarded by the Court will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. Because the negotiations were confidential mediation communications, this statement describes the process and final terms without recounting the parties’ intermediate offers.
